purpose: Close the remaining PR #821 performance gap in the Pico port while retaining sampling and sampled DSpark.
baselineDefinition: Previous partial port at the start of this optimization round; it already contained expert fusion and final-row prefill. PR #821 is a separate control, not the percentage baseline.

model.weights: Same normalized checkpoint in every arm; no requantization.

method.greedy: Identical reconciliation harness; serial balanced A,B,C,C,B,A; two full 128-step warmups per prompt, then three measured rounds per process. Decode starts after the first token and pipeline prime; GPU fence at both ends.
method.sampled: Identical before/after harness; A,B,B,A; two full 128-step warmups, then three measured rounds. Temperature 0.8, topP 0.9, seed 7. DSpark block size 4.
method.isolation: No simultaneous benchmark models; compiler activity polled every 0.25 seconds and overlapping attempts discarded/retried.
method.comparability: Percentages use medians within this campaign and sampling mode. Greedy and sampling harnesses are not used as cross-mode baselines.

changes: Fused attention convolution, clipping and value normalization with float32 history
Fused residual/depth mixing and native-order RMS
Reduced compiled-trace state to the modules each half reads
Single-SIMD top-eight routing with original tie/NaN/normalization semantics

validation.incrementalReferenceLogitError: 0.0 at all checked positions in the quantized BF16/head128 regression
validation.liveParameterUpdates: normal and rewind compiled traces match a cold clone bit for bit
validation.rmsPrecision: Exact tests cover D16/64/128/2304/4096, B1/2/8 and multiple seeds; Xcode-native reciprocal multiplication preserved.

earlierTrials.a1g1: Incomplete optimization; final table uses the complete corrected source.
earlierTrials.nativeRMSBeforeFinalCorrection: Performance trial excluded from final results; its non-power-of-two RMS precision discrepancy was fixed and the full suite rerun.

routerMicrobenchmark.conclusion: Neutral within measurement noise; no individual throughput gain attributed to R1. All checked outputs bit-identical.

sourceManifest.originalWrapperChanges: Kernel holder reference only; source/math/wrapper arguments preserved

results.correctness: First8 invocations were bit-identical across all variants and rounds; distinct inputs produced distinct outputs
results.recommendation: Keep R1: compiled measurements are neutral within noise, with no demonstrated slowdown or speedup; no additional ablation/rebenchmark.
